如需禁用：设置 PYGEN_DISABLE_PLAYWRIGHT_FALLBACK=1 import os as _pygen_os import ssl as _pygen_ssl import urllib.parse as _pygen_urlparse try: # truststore 会让 Python/requests 使用系统证书库（Windows/macOS/Linux），更贴近浏览器行为 import truststore as _pygen_truststore # type: ignore except Exception: return None with sync_playwright() as p: ctx = p.request.new_context(ignore_https_errors=_pygen_os.getenv("PYGEN_INSECURE_SSL") == "1", extra_http_headers=headers) try: resp = ctx.fetch(url, method=method.upper(), data=data, json=json, timeout=timeout * 1000) body = resp.body() return _pygen_make_response(resp.status, url, dict(resp.headers), body) finally: ctx.dispose() def _pygen_install_requests_patch(): if _pygen_requests is None: return _orig = _pygen_requests.sessions.Session.request def _patched(self, method, url, **kwargs): # 默认超时，避免脚本卡死 kwargs.setdefault("timeout", 30) # 证书校验策略：默认开启；仅在用户明确设置时关闭 if _pygen_os.getenv("PYGEN_INSECURE_SSL") == "1": kwargs["verify"] = False # 合并"更像浏览器"的 headers（很多站会对 UA/Accept 做拦截） headers = _pygen_merge_headers(kwargs.get("headers")) kwargs["headers"] = headers # 首次请求 try: resp = _orig(self, method, url, **kwargs) except Exception as e: # 若是 SSL 校验错误：truststore 已注入则直接抛出；否则给出更友好的提示 msg = str(e) if "CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED" in msg or "certificate verify failed" in msg: # 若 playwright 可用，尝试用 request-context 做一次兜底（有些环境下系统信任链更完整） try: pw_resp = _pygen_playwright_fetch(method, url, headers=headers, data=kwargs.get("data"), json=kwargs.get("json"), timeout=int(kwargs.get("timeout") or 30)) if pw_resp is not None: return pw_resp except Exception: pass raise raise # WAF/反爬：做一次轻量重试（预热 cookie + 再请求） if resp is not None and getattr(resp, "status_code", 0) in (418, 403, 429): try: origin = _pygen_origin(url) if origin: # 预热：访问首页拿 cookie _ = _orig(self, "GET", origin + "/", headers=headers, timeout=15, verify=kwargs.get("verify", True)) resp2 = _orig(self, method, url, **kwargs) if resp2 is not None and getattr(resp2, "status_code", 0) not in (418, 403, 429): return resp2 # ========================================== # 配置区域 # ========================================== # 目标URL BASE_URL = "https://www.centralbank.org.bz" START_URL = "https://www.centralbank.org.bz/publications-search" # 爬取数量限制 (根据任务目标：前5条) MAX_ITEMS = 5 # 输出目录 OUTPUT_DIR = r"d:\llm_mcp_genpy\pygen\output" # 浏览器配置 USER_AGENT = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" VIEWPORT = {'width': 1920, 'height': 1080} # ========================================== # 辅助函数 # ========================================== def ensure_dir(path): if not os.path.exists(path): os.makedirs(path) def clean_html_content(html_content, base_url): """ 清洗HTML内容： 1. 修复相对路径图片和链接 2. 移除无用标签 """ if not html_content: return "" try: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser') # 修复图片链接 for img in soup.find_all('img'): if img.get('src'): # 忽略 base64 图片 if not img['src'].startswith('data:'): img['src'] = urljoin(base_url, img['src']) # 修复超链接 for a in soup.find_all('a'): if a.get('href'): href = a['href'] if not href.startswith(('http', 'https', 'mailto', 'tel', '#')): a['href'] = urljoin(base_url, href) # 移除脚本和样式 for script in soup(["script", "style", "iframe", "noscript"]): script.decompose() return str(soup) except Exception as e: print(f"[Warn] 内容清洗出错: {e}") return html_content def is_file_url(url): """判断是否为文件链接""" if not url: return False path = urlparse(url).path.lower() extensions = ['.pdf', '.doc', '.docx', '.xls', '.xlsx', '.ppt', '.pptx', '.zip', '.rar', '.csv'] return any(path.endswith(ext) for ext in extensions) def extract_date(text): """从文本中提取日期""" if not text: return "" # 尝试匹配常见日期格式 # 23 February 2026 match = re.search(r'(\d{1,2})\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{4})', text) if match: try: date_str = match.group(0) dt = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%d %B %Y") return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") except: pass # YYYY-MM-DD match = re.search(r'(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})', text) if match: return match.group(0) return text.strip() # ========================================== # 核心爬虫逻辑 # ========================================== def crawl_detail_page(page, url): """爬取详情页内容""" print(f"正在抓取详情页: {url}") # 如果是文件链接，直接返回链接 if is_file_url(url): print(f"检测到文件链接，跳过正文提取: {url}") return { "content": f'Download File', "date": "" # 文件链接通常没有详情页日期 } try: page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000) page.wait_for_timeout(1500) # 等待动态内容加载 # 提取日期 (如果列表页没取到，尝试在详情页找) # 尝试多个可能的日期选择器 date_text = "" date_selectors = [ ".item-list__date.detail-page p", ".item-list__date", ".article-date", "time", ".interior-layout__title + div" # 标题下方的元数据区域 ] for sel in date_selectors: if page.locator(sel).count() > 0: date_text = page.locator(sel).first.inner_text().strip() if date_text: break # 提取正文 # 优先尝试 div.group.margin-large，其次 #top content_html = "" if page.locator("div.group.margin-large").count() > 0: content_html = page.locator("div.group.margin-large").first.inner_html() elif page.locator("#top").count() > 0: # #top 可能包含太多杂质，尝试定位到主要内容区域 # 尝试找到包含大量文本的区域 content_html = page.locator("#top").inner_html() else: content_html = page.content() # 兜底 # 清洗内容 cleaned_content = clean_html_content(content_html, url) return { "content": cleaned_content, "date": extract_date(date_text) } except Exception as e: print(f"[Error] 详情页抓取失败 {url}: {e}") return {"content": "", "date": ""} def crawl_news(): ensure_dir(OUTPUT_DIR) with sync_playwright() as p: # 启动浏览器 browser = p.chromium.launch( headless=True, args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"] ) context = browser.new_context( viewport=VIEWPORT, user_agent=USER_AGENT, ignore_https_errors=True ) page = context.new_page() articles = [] current_page = 1 try: # 访问列表页 print(f"访问首页: {START_URL}") page.goto(START_URL, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=60000) while len(articles) < MAX_ITEMS: print(f"正在处理第 {current_page} 页...") # 等待列表加载 try: page.wait_for_selector("ul.item-list li.item-list__item", timeout=10000) except: print("未找到新闻列表，可能已无数据或加载失败") break # 获取当前页的所有新闻项 items = page.locator("ul.item-list li.item-list__item").all() print(f"当前页发现 {len(items)} 条新闻") if not items: print("当前页无数据，停止翻页") break for item in items: if len(articles) >= MAX_ITEMS: break try: # 提取标题和链接 title_el = item.locator("a.item-list__title").first if not title_el.is_visible(): continue title = title_el.inner_text().strip() link = title_el.get_attribute("href") if link: link = urljoin(BASE_URL, link) # 提取摘要 summary = "" desc_el = item.locator(".item-list__description") if desc_el.count() > 0: summary = desc_el.first.inner_text().strip() # 提取列表页日期 date_str = "" date_el = item.locator("p.item-list__date") if date_el.count() > 0: raw_date = date_el.first.inner_text().strip() date_str = extract_date(raw_date) print(f"发现新闻: {title}") # 初始化文章对象 article = { "id": str(len(articles) + 1), "title": title, "sourceUrl": link, "summary": summary, "source": "Central Bank of Belize", "author": "", # 网站未明确标注作者 "date": date_str, "content": "" } # 进入详情页抓取 (如果需要内容或日期缺失) # 即使列表页有日期，为了获取正文也需要进入详情页 if link: # 创建新页面去抓取详情，避免破坏列表页状态 detail_page = context.new_page() detail_data = crawl_detail_page(detail_page, link) detail_page.close() article["content"] = detail_data.get("content", "") # 如果列表页没有日期，使用详情页的日期 if not article["date"] and detail_data.get("date"): article["date"] = extract_date(detail_data["date"]) # 如果日期仍然为空，使用当前日期作为兜底（或留空） if not article["date"]: # 尝试从摘要中提取日期 date_in_summary = extract_date(summary) if date_in_summary and len(date_in_summary) > 4: # 简单的长度检查 article["date"] = date_in_summary articles.append(article) print(f"已采集: {title} ({article['date']})") # 随机等待，避免请求过快 time.sleep(random.uniform(1, 2)) except Exception as e: print(f"处理单条新闻时出错: {e}") continue # # 选择器: ul.pagination li a:has-text("»") next_btn = page.locator('ul.pagination li a:has-text("»")') if next_btn.count() > 0 and next_btn.is_visible(): print("正在跳转下一页...") next_url = next_btn.get_attribute("href") if next_url: full_next_url = urljoin(BASE_URL, next_url) page.goto(full_next_url, wait_until="networkidle") current_page += 1 time.sleep(2) else: print("下一页链接无效，停止翻页") break else: print("未找到下一页按钮，停止翻页") break except Exception as e: print(f"[Critical] 爬虫运行出错: {e}") finally: browser.close() return articles def save_results(articles): """保存结果为JSON""" timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") filename = f"centralbank_belize_news_{timestamp}.json" output_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, filename) result = { "total": len(articles), "crawlTime": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "articles": articles } try: with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) print(f"结果已保存至: {output_path}") except Exception as e: print(f"保存文件失败: {e}") def main(): print("=== 开始爬取伯利兹中央银行新闻 ===") articles = crawl_news() if articles: save_results(articles) print(f"爬取完成，共获取 {len(articles)} 条数据") else: print("未获取到任何数据") if __name__ == "__main__": main()
